**Rev A (superseded, kept for reference):** `durian_iot_schematic.drawio/.png/.svg` produced by `generate_schematic.py`.
The `.drawio` files are editable in diagrams.net; KiCad is not installed on this machine, so no `.kicad_sch` exists.

Conventions: solid line = connection declared in firmware (and, where stated, confirmed by runtime data);
dashed line / "(?)" = assumed or unverified. The coffee-project schematic (ESP32-CAM + DHT11 + LDR + YL-69 via
ADS1115) was used only as a presentation reference; none of its parts or wiring are assumed here.

## 1. Two separate devices

| Device | Board | Firmware | Link to backend | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **esp32-01** — sensor station | ESP32 (chip ESP32-D0WD-V3 rev 3.1, MAC `8c:94:df:69:1c:6c`) | `Documents/Arduino/sketch_jul25a` (1.3.0, FQBN `esp32:esp32:esp32`) | Wi-Fi STA → HTTP `POST /api/v1/sensors/data`, server via UDP 4210 discovery | `esptool read-mac` on COM3; firmware; telemetry rows in PostgreSQL |
| **ESP32-CAM-001** — camera | AI-Thinker ESP32-CAM (`CAMERA_MODEL_AI_THINKER`, PSRAM) — MAC `68:09:47:2D:8E:60` | `Documents/Arduino/CameraWebServer` (2.1.0, FQBN `esp32:esp32:esp32cam`) | Wi-Fi → signed registry register/heartbeat, snapshots pulled by iot-service | `board_config.h`; snapshots received by the backend (19/10/2026) |

They are drawn as two independent boards; no GPIO or firmware is shared.

## 3. Pin mapping

### esp32-01 (U1)

| U1 pin | Net | To | Direction | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GPIO18 | DHT_DATA | S1 DATA (+ R1 to 3V3 if needed) | bidirectional 1-wire | not a strapping pin |
| GPIO34 | SOIL_AO | S2 AO | analog in | ADC1_CH6, input-only, works with Wi-Fi on (ADC2 would not); 0–3.3 V max |
| 3V3 | +3V3 | S1 VCC, S2 VCC, R1 | power out | from board regulator (assumed) |
| GND | GND | S1 GND, S2 GND | — | common ground |
| VIN / 5V | +5V | USB | power in | unverified |

### ESP32-CAM-001 (U2) — fixed AI-Thinker map used by the firmware

| Function | GPIO | | Function | GPIO |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PWDN | 32 | | Y9 / Y8 / Y7 / Y6 | 35 / 34 / 39 / 36 |
| XCLK | 0 | | Y5 / Y4 / Y3 / Y2 | 21 / 19 / 18 / 5 |
| SIOD (SCCB SDA) | 26 | | VSYNC / HREF / PCLK | 25 / 23 / 22 |
| SIOC (SCCB SCL) | 27 | | Flash LED | 4 |
| RESET | — (−1) | | UART0 RX / TX | 3 / 1 (programming / serial log) |

No external sensor is attached to U2: almost every free GPIO is taken by the camera, PSRAM or SD slot.

## 4. Circuit checks

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Logic levels | U1 is 3.3 V. DHT22 at 3.3 V: OK. S2 AO must stay ≤ 3.3 V → power S2 from 3V3, **not** 5 V. |
| ADC choice | GPIO34 is ADC1 — usable while Wi-Fi is on. ESP32 ADC is non-linear near the rails; the firmware's 3200/1200 calibration is empirical. |
| Strapping pins | GPIO18 and GPIO34 are not strapping pins. U2: GPIO0 (XCLK) must be pulled low only when flashing. |
| GPIO conflicts | None on U1. Report B's GPIO23/GPIO35 are unused by the current firmware. U2 GPIO18 is a camera data line — another reason not to share firmware/pins between the boards. |
| I2C | Not used by either device (the camera's SCCB on 26/27 is internal). No address conflicts. |
| Power | U2 brown-outs are common below ~500 mA at 5 V with Wi-Fi + camera (+ flash LED); a dedicated 5 V ≥ 1 A supply is recommended. |
| 3V3 sharing | U1 has a single 3V3 pin feeding both S1 and S2, so a split point (breadboard rail, Y-lead or solder joint) must exist — how it is done is unverified (J1 in Rev B). |
| Suspicious data | S2 raw ≈ 0 in nearly every reading → AO shorted to GND, VCC missing, probe dry and module inverted, or wrong pin. Check with a multimeter before the hardware test phase. |

No firmware was changed to make the drawing consistent.

## 7. Questions for the owner (to close the dashed items)

1. Exact board for esp32-01: DevKit V1 (30-pin), DevKitC (38-pin) or another? (photo of the board is enough)
2. Is the DHT22 a 3-pin module (pull-up on board) or a 4-pin bare sensor? Which pin feeds its VCC: 3V3 or 5V?
3. Soil module VCC: 3V3 or 5V? Is AO really on GPIO34? (raw ≈ 0 in the logs)
4. Does a rain sensor or light sensor physically exist?
5. How is the ESP32-CAM powered and flashed (ESP32-CAM-MB, USB-TTL, external 5 V adapter)?
6. Any extra parts (enclosure, solar/battery, regulators) that should be in the BOM?

## 8. Opening and editing

- **draw.io / diagrams.net**: desktop app (free) or https://app.diagrams.net → *File → Open* →
  `durian_iot_schematic.drawio`. Boxes, labels and wires are normal shapes; dashed style marks unverified links.
- **Regenerate** after changing parts or pins in code: `python docs/hardware/generate_schematic.py`
  (needs Python with matplotlib). This overwrites the three outputs.
- **KiCad**: not installed on this machine, so no `.kicad_sch` was produced (an unvalidated KiCad file could open
  broken). Once KiCad is installed, the same component/pin tables can be turned into a KiCad schematic and checked
  with `kicad-cli sch erc`.
